1. Mr. Yogesh Pant, learned counsel for 
the revisionist in (CLR No. 36 of 2026) and 
Mr. Deepak Joshi, learned counsel for the 
respondent in (CLR No. 15 of 2026). 
Mr. M.S.Tyagi, learned Senior Advocate, 
assisted by Mr. Yogesh Pant and Mr. Sunil 
Chandra, learned counsel for the revisionist 
in CLR No. 15 and appearing as respondents 
in (CLR No. 36 of 2026). 
3. A letter has been received from the In￾charge, Civil Judge (S/D), Haldwani, 
Nainital, whereby the trial court records,
which were summoned by this Court, have 
been asked to be returned for the 
compliance of the order dated 21.08.2026, 
passed by the Supreme Court, in Misc. 
Application No. 1129 of 2026 in SLP (C ) No. 
19986 of 2022. As per the said order, the 
Civil Judge, Haldwani, has been directed by  the Court to undertake inspection/survey of 
the plot in question along with the 
Government surveyor and the report is to be 
submitted before the Supreme Court on or 
before 23.09.2026.
4. Registry is directed to remit the lower 
court record through Special Messenger to 
the court of In-charge, Civil Judge (S/D), 
District Nainital by 13.09.2026. 
6. Interim order dated 27.03.2026
passed in connected Civil Revision No. 15 of 
2026 shall continue to operate till the next 
date of listing.
7. List on 09.10.2026.
